The offer-level candidates combine an offer-level promotional connection with an existential non-discount gift component. Establish that the identified gift component bears the required promotional connection; otherwise facts about unrelated components could produce an unsupported prohibition.

Unit db43e253bea18.u0.2 defines distributors in the context of SFC-authorised funds, whereas u13.2987 describes a specific investment product or product type. Broader distributor wording in some candidates and node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f's narrower specific-fund wording require reconciliation with those distinct scopes.

The full Code of Conduct paragraph 3.11 and the answer to question 1 of the SFC FAQs issued on 30 September 2010, referenced in footnote 3, are missing external authorities. Can their applicable texts be supplied to check additional qualifications and gift classifications? No dependency IDs are supplied.

Guaranteed returns and incentives may be gifts; classification is not automatic. Unit db43e253bea18.u7.1360 distinguishes fund return from distributor top-up. A discount in one component cannot establish the exception for another component.

Neither the discount exception nor TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT establishes overall legality. Structured-product status is not a prerequisite for the gift restriction, and section 103 authorisation is not a stated gift-rule exception.
The supplied source does not establish an operative date interval. The candidates' temporal_basis declarations and uncertainty semantics do not independently establish the applicable legal version.
